messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up everyone — rolling out the automated annual attestation flow tomorrow morning. This replaces the old Google Form and should cut reminder noise by ~80%. Please read the quick notes below and complete your attestation within 72 hours of receiving the DM.

Maya (People Ops): TL;DR:
- Attestation portal: https://internal.redwood/attest-2026
- You will get a direct DM from OpsBot (SSO-verified).
- If you manage buyer/vendor data, choose the correct scope during attestation.
- Contractors: you'll get a separate contractor flow (48h window).

Priya (People Ops): New features: auto-tagging of attestation responses, CSV export for auditors, and a one-click exception request. We added a short 4-minute microtraining for data handling that pops up if you select any high-risk scope.

Devon (Eng): Quick Q: how does this affect service accounts and CI users? They can't SSO.

Jordan (Security): Good Q. We created a svc-account attestation path. Owners for each service account will be pinged via the team channel and must confirm config + rotate keys if flagged. Automation will list unverified service accounts weekly.

Nina (Legal): Reminder: attestation acknowledges understanding of the updated Data Retention Policy (v2.1). If you represent a customer-facing team, double-check the customer data handling checkbox. Legal will sample 10% of responses for contract risk.

Maya (People Ops): Timeline:
- 2026-05-01 09:00 UTC: OpsBot begins DMing employees in batches (by org tree).
- 2026-05-03 09:00 UTC: Reminder batch 1 for non-responders.
- 2026-05-05 09:00 UTC: Final reminder + manager escalation.
- 2026-05-08 23:59 UTC: Attestation window closes for employees.

OpsBot: Reminder queued  attestation rollout starts 2026-05-01T09:00:00Z. You will receive a DM from @OpsBot with the attestation link.

Devon (Eng): Will the attestation count as mandatory training for the year? Want to check against my team's training tracker.

Priya (People Ops): It's an annual attestation, not the full training. We'll mark completion in the HR tracker and it will satisfy the attestation requirement. If you fail the attestation, we'll route you to the 20-minute refresher module.

Jordan (Security): For auditors: all attestation logs (who, when, IP, SSO token hash, answers) will be exported and signed. We keep the logs for 7 years per retention policy. If anyone needs a redaction (PII in free-text), submit a redaction request and include redaction-log.txt.

Maya (People Ops): Exceptions: managers can request a one-week extension for folks on PTO or critical launches via the exception form: https://internal.redwood/attest-exceptions. Approvals go to People Ops + Security.

Devon (Eng): Contractors with expired SSO still show up in our roster. Will they be excluded automatically?

Priya (People Ops): Contractors are flagged; they get the contractor flow and a dedicated 48h window. If access is expired, the contractor owner must confirm status before the flow triggers.

Nina (Legal): FYI: Please do not include customer names in free-text answers unless strictly required; if you must, mark it as 'customer-redaction' and we'll handle it.

Maya (People Ops): We'll post a one-page FAQ and short video by EOD. If you hit any technical problems (DM not arriving, SSO error), open a ticket in #help-peopleops and tag @Priya.

Jordan (Security): Also, if you see any suspicious bulk DMs or phishing attempts claiming to be OpsBot, DM Security immediately. The real OpsBot will only DM from @OpsBot and include an SSO link with redwood.com domain.

Devon (Eng): Thanks — planning to block 30m for my team to complete these together.

Maya (People Ops): Amazing — appreciate the team sessions. We'll surface manager dashboards next week so you can see who completed. :white_check_mark:
